_file_note: Notes for app/data/model/sim_action.json: where each field came from, who writes and reads it, and the rules it must obey. The field's type, allowed answers, required-ness and column type live with the class in app/models/. Merged by app/repositories/model_catalogue_repository.py.
about: One agent action in a simulation: a line in actions.jsonl, and an entry in run_state recent_actions.
rules: Token and cost fields are counts from the model call, never estimates by the model.

action_args.note: Shape depends on action_type (content, topics, opinion ids, target, feed_size, event).
